# Inline HTML Tags

## Keyboard and code

Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>B</kbd> to toggle bold.

The function <code>parseMarkdown()</code> takes a string.

## Bold and emphasis via HTML

This text has <b>bold</b> and <i>italic</i> and <em>emphasis</em>
and <strong>strong</strong> all mixed.

## Span with class

A sentence with <span class="highlight">highlighted text</span> in the middle.

<span style="color: red">Red text via inline style.</span>

## Line break

First line<br>
Second line after a br<br/>
Third line after self-closing br

## Subscript and superscript

Water is H<sub>2</sub>O and Einstein's equation is E = mc<sup>2</sup>.

## Mark and del

This is <mark>highlighted</mark> and this is <del>deleted</del>.

## Small and abbr

<small>Small print at the bottom.</small>

The <abbr title="World Wide Web Consortium">W3C</abbr> sets web standards.

## Combined inline

Paragraph with <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>, <code>inline()</code>, <b>bold</b>,
<i>italic</i>, <mark>mark</mark>, <del>deleted</del>, H<sub>2</sub>O,
and x<sup>2</sup> all together.

## Inline in list

- Item with <code>inline code</code> in it
- Item with <kbd>Ctrl+S</kbd> shortcut
- Item with <mark>highlighted</mark> word
